input.description: Binary image data. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF. Maximum size: 1MB (1,000,000 bytes).

blob.description: Blob reference object that can be used in post embeds (app.bsky.embed.images).

main.description: Upload an image blob for scheduled posts. The blob is temporarily stored in Chronosky's storage and will be uploaded to Bluesky PDS when the scheduled post is published.
